originalData.title: Full Stack Engineer
originalData.description: BrandBack is a Berlin-based startup that helps brands protect their intellectual property and combat counterfeiting through advanced technology solutions. We're building innovative tools to help companies monitor, detect, and take action against brand infringement across digital platforms. As a Full Stack Engineer at BrandBack, you'll be responsible for developing and maintaining our web applications, working on both frontend and backend systems. You'll collaborate with a small, agile team to build scalable solutions that directly impact our clients' ability to protect their brands. The role involves working with modern web technologies, implementing new features, optimizing performance, and ensuring code quality. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging problems in the brand protection space, including data processing, machine learning integration, and user interface design. The position offers flexibility with hybrid work arrangements, allowing you to work both from our Berlin office and remotely. We're looking for someone who is passionate about technology, enjoys working in a startup environment, and wants to make a real impact in helping brands protect their intellectual property.
originalData.requirements: ["Experience with full-stack web development","Proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks","Backend development experience with API design","Database design and management skills","Understanding of software development best practices","Ability to work in an agile startup environment","Strong problem-solving and debugging skills"]
